When Filbert P. Horsefeathers walks into George Crum's restaurant, he tells the waitress, “I have a hankering for a heaping helping of potatoes.” Talented cook that he is, George prepares a serving of his most scrumptious, succulent, and sublime potato wedges—only to have Filbert send them back. “Too thick,” he says. “Too bland.” So, George makes thinner, saltier wedges.

But this picky customer isn’t satisfied with the new dish. He sends them back again. Feeling a bit mischievous, George decides to make the thinnest, most overcooked, most salty potatoes of his entire cooking career. What happens next surprises everyone—and leaves the whole world clamoring for more.

Though a work of fiction, Mr. Crum’s Potato Predicament is based on a real George Crum (of mixed Native American and African American descent), who is said to have created the first potato chip in response to a demanding customer. The playful writing is filled with vocabulary words, along with themes of persistence, creativity, and using cleverness to handle challenging social situations. snippet.title: THE PSYCHOLOGY OF MONEY (BY MORGAN HOUSEL) - Book Summary
snippet.description:
IT'S GOOD TO BE BACK! Welcome all my new friends here and the OGs. I appreciate all of you more than you know for your continued enthusiasm and support. I love you all. The Psychology of Money by Morgan Housel is one of the best books I've come across in recent years. I hope you enjoy this Book Summary. Thank you thank you thank you!

Here's a teaser for the video:

A janitor accumulates an unimaginable fortune, while a tech genius who made millions in his 20s winds up broke... What's going on here? In The Psychology of Money, the author (Morgan Housel) approaches the topic of finance from a very unique perspective--with a focus entirely on psychology, behavior, and habits. He uses a series of stories and analogies to prove his point that behavior, not IQ or fancy degrees, is the major factor that determines our financial outcome. 

This book speaks to a truth we all know to be true--a truth that is rarely acknowledged, much less examined. The truth that anyone can be rich if they adopt the proper set of behaviors and habits, and if they recognize those psychological roadblocks that harm all of us and hold us back from what we all want to achieve. 

I hope you tune into this video, and I hope you find it helpful to your life. I know I did.

snippet.title: The Intelligent Investor, by Benjamin Graham - Animated Book Summary
snippet.description:
Welcome to this Animated Book Summary of The Intelligent Investor, by Benjamin Graham, "The Definitive Book on Value Investing." In this animated summary of Benjamin Graham's timeless classic, you'll get the 3 Key Takeaways.

Here's what Warren Buffett said about The Intelligent Investor:
“By far the best book on investing ever written.”
- Warren Buffett

00:36 - Two requirements for successful investing

01:28 - Decide what kind of investor you're going to be
01:54 - Defensive Investor or “Passive Investor”
02:42 - 7 Investing Rules for the Defensive Investor
04:54 - Enterprising Investor or “Active Investor”
05:32 - 5 Investing Rules for the Enterprising Investor
 08:03 - Learn how to do business with Mr. Market
09:03 - 3 Rules for Doing Business with Mr. Market
10:25 - Practice Margin of Safety
11:04 - Warren Buffet M.o.S. / Bridge Analogy
11:35 - Chart Explanation of the Margin of Safety
12:34 - Diversification vs. Margin of Safety
13:07 - Outro

The Intelligent Investor, by Benjamin Graham is the quintessential investing book. Whether you’re opening your first stock trade account or you’re a seasoned investor, The Intelligent Investor can help you step up your investing / stock trading game and make more money.

Benjamin Graham was an American economist and the “Father of Value Investing.” He was also Warren Buffet’s professor at Columbia Business School back in 1951. Buffet has said that he credits 85% of his investment style to the principles of Benjamin Graham. Warren Buffett also said of The Intelligent Investor: “Picking up that book was one of the luckiest moments of my life.”

The Intelligent Investor will change the way you view investing, and it will help you create an investing style of your own and (hopefully) make lots of money in the stock market. 

Access the Free Outline for The Intelligent Investor, by Benjamin Graham on Google Drive here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yTy3DNGDun0xqi6sLVtaHSWOwCvKt30l/view?usp=sharing

Enjoy.
